description: This file contains unit tests for the FileBasedCredentialsService class in the org.eclipse.hono.deviceregistry package. It verifies functionalities such as startup file creation, loading credentials from file, handling malformed JSON, and file persistence operations.

classes.name: FileBasedCredentialsServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for FileBasedCredentialsService, verifying startup procedures, file operations, credentials loading, and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and configures the testing environment before each test.

methods.name: testDoStartCreatesFile
methods.description: Tests that when the service starts with file persistence enabled, it creates missing credential and registration files.

methods.name: testDoStartFailsIfFileCannotBeCreated
methods.description: Tests startup failure when the credentials file cannot be created.

methods.name: testDoStartIgnoresMalformedJson
methods.description: Ensures startup proceeds even if the credentials or registration files contain malformed JSON.

methods.name: testDoStartLoadsCredentials
methods.description: Verifies credentials are loaded correctly from existing files during startup.

methods.name: testDoStartIgnoreCredentialIfStartEmptyIsSet
methods.description: Checks that credentials are not loaded if startEmpty configuration is enabled.

methods.name: testLoadCredentialsCanReadOutputOfSaveToFile
methods.description: Confirms that credentials saved to file can be read back and re-registered.

methods.name: testUpdateCredentialsFailsIfModificationIsDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that updates to credentials are blocked if modification is disabled.
